# Search1API

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://docs.search1api.com/introduction.md): Welcome to search1api documentation
- [Search](https://docs.search1api.com/api-reference/endpoint/search.md): Performs a search
- [News](https://docs.search1api.com/api-reference/endpoint/news.md): Performs a news search
- [Crawl](https://docs.search1api.com/api-reference/endpoint/crawl.md): Crawls a webpage
- [Sitemap](https://docs.search1api.com/api-reference/endpoint/sitemap.md): Get sitemap links from a website
- [Trending](https://docs.search1api.com/api-reference/endpoint/trending.md): Get trending topics from popular platforms
- [Reasoning](https://docs.search1api.com/api-reference/endpoint/reasoning.md): Create a chat completion
- [Models](https://docs.search1api.com/api-reference/endpoint/models.md): List all available models
- [Usage](https://docs.search1api.com/api-reference/endpoint/usage.md): Get usage
